name: Berlin Independent Film Festival 2027
description: BIFF presents another festival of independent filmmaking at one of Berlin's favourite independent cinemas. The Berlin Independent Film Festival is dedicated to showcasing emerging international film talent and low-budget filmmaking, with an emphasis on new filmmakers achieving great things with tiny budgets. BIFF runs alongside the Berlinale and European Film Market, positioning itself as a crucial business hub for the low-budget film industry with workshops and networking social events.
